mentions.name: Clean Links
mentions.description: On-device app that safely expands shortened links and removes tracking parameters from URLs and QR codes, released as a free app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently polishing up an on-device app that I wrote for myself a few months ago to safely expand shortened links and to get rid of tracking parameters from URLs and QR codes for release as a free app (https://cleanlinks.app).
